create.name: Katie Silcox
create.bio:
Katie Silcox is an American teacher of Ayurveda and Tantra whose work centres on women's spiritual lives and the rhythms of the body. She trained to master's level in Ayurveda, has practised yoga and studied Tantra for more than twenty years and is now exploring Jungian depth psychology. Before teaching full time she worked in artificial intelligence research, among other unexpected chapters. She wrote the bestselling Healthy, Happy, Sexy, an approachable guide to Ayurvedic daily life for modern women, and later Glow-Worthy, a mix of memoir and practice about self-worth grounded in spiritual identity.

She founded The Shakti School, an online school that teaches what she calls feminine-form Ayurveda alongside Tantric meditation and movement. Its year-long Level 1 programme trains students as Ayurvedic wellness coaches through weekly live lectures, while a monthly membership offers a live workshop with Katie and a library of meditations, movement classes and talks. She hosts the Spirit Sessions podcast, where she discusses Ayurveda, embodiment and spiritual practice with guests, and in 2027 she leads a Tantra retreat and gathering for the school's community at the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas. She lives in rural Virginia.

books.title: Glow-Worthy: Practices for Awakening Your Inner Light and Loving Yourself As You Are: Broken, Beautiful, and Sacred
books.author: Katie Silcox
books.description: Katie's second book blends her own story with Tantric and yogic practices for building self-worth on a spiritual footing. It is written for women of any faith or none.

courses.title: Shakti Ayurveda School Level 1: Ayurvedic Wellness Coach
courses.description: A 300-hour online training over a year in Katie's woman-centred approach to Ayurveda and Tantra, taught mostly through weekly live-streamed lectures with recordings. Graduates are certified as Ayurvedic wellness coaches; payment plans are offered.

courses.title: Spirit Sessions Membership
courses.description: A monthly online membership with a live workshop led by Katie or a guest teacher each month. Members also get an archive of more than a hundred meditations, movement classes and lectures.

courses.title: The Shakti School's Tantra Retreat and Grand Gathering May 2027
courses.description: A four-day residential gathering for the school's community at a Bahamas ashram, where Katie leads an embodied Tantra immersion that works through the chakras. It is open to everyone, including partners and friends of students.

free_resources.title: Women's Wisdom Ayurveda Mini-Course
free_resources.description: A free introductory course of about four hours on Ayurveda and women's wisdom, sent by email when you join the school's mailing list. It is offered as a starting point before the longer training.
